==Usage instructions==
<code><nowiki>{{CANvotes|{{subst:FULLPAGENAME}}}}</nowiki></code>

Note:
*Use the actual fullpagename including namespace at the beginning, for example, '''Wookieepedia:Comprehensive article nominations/DS-55-2'''. <span style="color: red;">Do <u>NOT</u> use the magic word <nowiki>{{FULLPAGENAME}}</nowiki> on its own</span>, as the vote counts will be zero on pages such as [[Wookieepedia:Comprehensive article nominations]].
